NoSQLServer v0.32 database_core v0.22 compatibility adapter validation

Runtime:
  Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196 (64-bit)

Primary compatibility smoke:
  tests/v032_database_core_adapter_smoke.rex
  NOSQLSERVER V0.32 DATABASE_CORE ADAPTER SMOKE: OK

Validated compatibility behavior:
  - db~databaseCore returns namespaced .NoSQLDatabaseCoreAdapter.
  - Native NoSQLServer API remains unchanged.
  - Successful compatibility commit: status=SUCCESS, outcome=COMMITTED.
  - Pre-execution conflict: status/outcome=NOTEXECUTED and error=SERIALIZATIONFAILURE.
  - Whole-transaction retry succeeds on a fresh snapshot; attemptCount=2/retried=true.
  - Deferred query result resolves only from the final successful retry and sees the fresh live snapshot.
  - Read-only transactions reject mutation before it is queued.
  - DEFAULT/SERIALIZABLE isolation accepted; unsupported isolation levels return UNSUPPORTED.
  - setTimeout returns UNSUPPORTED and TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT is not advertised.
  - queryWithSchema applies type vectors by output ordinal while preserving SQL output names.
  - Invalid/contradictory typed results return INVALIDPARAMETER.
  - Compatibility row at(name) returns value object; rawAt/valueAt match database_core semantics.
  - Metadata exposes engineType/databaseType/nullable/ordinal and types vector.
  - Ordered mutationResults preserve one result per ordinary mutation and per prepared-batch member.
  - generatedKey surface is reserved and remains .nil.
  - Core-style logical operation history counts prepared declaration/savepoint control operations.

Regression gates:
  Claude torture corpus: 12/12 PASS, all oracle-backed, 0 WRONG_RESULT.
  Grok hell corpus v1: 24/25 PASS, 1 deliberate SQLUNSUPPORTED, 0 WRONG_RESULT.
  Grok SQL feature torture: 72/72 expected behaviours.
  SQL-92 company smoke: PASS.
  Historical runtime smoke chain through v0.31: PASS.
  rexxc: NoSQLServer.cls and every tests/*.rex PASS.

Deliberate boundaries:
  - The compatibility facade is namespaced. Do not ::requires database_core.cls and
    NoSQLServer.cls into the same package namespace because same-named public classes
    have different observable semantics.
  - TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT is not advertised; no enforceable transaction deadline exists.
  - GENERATED_KEYS is not advertised; generatedKey remains .nil.
  - READUNCOMMITTED, READCOMMITTED, and REPEATABLEREAD are not claimed as distinct
    native isolation modes.
